research.title: Intent Classification Under Meaning-Preserving Paraphrases
bullets: Designed experiments with supervisor guidance to compare intent classifier predictions across original utterances and paraphrases preserving the requested action.
Evaluated lexical and transformer baselines, grouped errors by paraphrase type, and inspected prediction changes involving negation and indirect requests.

research.title: Domain-Specific Lexical Cues in Review Sentiment Classification
bullets: Planned cross-domain sentiment experiments with supervisor guidance, separating review categories to examine reliance on domain-specific vocabulary.
Implemented lexical masking comparisons and analyzed classification errors to distinguish sentiment-bearing expressions from category cues across training and evaluation domains.

publications.title: Examining Domain-Specific Lexical Cues Through Masking in Cross-Domain Sentiment Classification

work.title: Inventory Records and Order Coordination
bullets: Checked incoming delivery paperwork against received items, recorded discrepancies, and routed unresolved issues to the appropriate staff.
Maintained stock records, organized order documents, and coordinated routine pickup arrangements using established procedures and daily task lists.

projects.title: Comparative Evaluation of Named Entity Taggers
bullets: Implemented token classification baselines using linear and recurrent models, applying consistent tokenization and label mappings across training and evaluation.
Compared entity-level precision and recall, then inspected boundary errors and confusion between organization and location labels.

projects.title: Lexical and Dense Retrieval for Question Matching
bullets: Implemented term-weighted and sentence-embedding retrieval pipelines to rank candidate questions, using shared preprocessing and identical evaluation queries.
Compared ranking quality and inspected mismatches involving rare terminology, short queries, and semantically related questions with different answer requirements.
